acceptance_criteria: Execution owner shares a two-second shutdown deadline across workers and rejects late admission safely.
Budget views share ownership; independent clones preserve policy with fresh Process/Stream registries.
Opaque non-reused IDs prevent cross-owner registry collisions; shutdown failures remain structured.
features.notes: PASS: owner hierarchy, safe late admission, policy-preserving fresh registries, shared budget ownership, structured stop/deadline failures; focused native/race evidence worker-owner-ai-race.log. Twenty stalled child owners share one two-second deadline.

acceptance_criteria: Closed stdin retains worker ownership until reaping; cooperative queued writes drain.
cancelProcess returns typed results, enforces Process authority, stops owned POSIX groups and joins writer/Wait.
Natural exit, repeated cancellation, concurrent write/close, stale/foreign handles and Windows/WASM unsupported results are tested.
features.notes: PASS: focused managed lifecycle/cancellation race tests repeated three times; actual checked descendant PID probe, direct ProcessState reaping, queued stdin drain, blocked writes and bystander isolation. Native showcase and inline tests pass; Windows/WASM cross-builds pass.

acceptance_criteria: cancelProcessSource enforces Stream and Process authority and rejects non-process sources.
Async workers have one natural-exit Wait owner; final chunks drain and blocked consumers do not prevent cancellation.
Source selection borrows sources; cancellation stops descendants and joins owned readers without closing borrowed stdin/connections.
features.notes: PASS: async lifecycle/cancellation races repeated ten times; source/borrowed-input lease cases repeated twenty times. Natural final chunks, inherited descendants, full queue, handle isolation and Stream/Process budgets verified. Actual WASM typed-unsupported runtime test passed under Node; Windows compile passed.

acceptance_criteria: CLI/batch normal, error, exit(7), budget failure and cancellation clean up owned workers while preserving primary outcomes.
SIGINT/SIGTERM restore terminal first, clean workers within the deadline, and retain 130/143 without signal-watcher deadlock.
Embedded requests, engine initialization/close and REPL reset/quit have explicit independent ownership; WebSocket close-code and borrowed-transport behavior is preserved.
Strict VM supports the new Process operations through explicit effect dispatch; unsupported generated/platform paths fail visibly.
features.notes: PASS: native/strict VM exact-PID CLI/batch matrix,11 worker PTY cases,normal/error/exit/budget/signals,active engine close during mocked AI call,borrowed base isolation,REPL reset and WebSocket1011/1001. Full host focused race and vet pass; strict VM effect dispatch and explicit unsupported backend behavior pass.

Provider-free blocking AI/effect, descendant, bystander, admission-race, 20-worker deadline and repeated-run resource controls pass.
Design conflict fixtures, examples/manifest, goldens, relevant race/PTy tests, full tests, lint, formatting, file sizes and architecture boundaries pass.
